What we install

Five techniques, one standard.

Sew-Ins

Hand-stitched wefts on a braided foundation for a natural part and long-term hold.

K-Tips

Fused, strand-by-strand keratin bonds that sit flat against the scalp and move freely.

LA-Weave

A lightweight, tension-free track method built for versatile styling and a breathable base.

Custom Wigs

Hand-tied lace units, mapped and cut to your hairline, density and part preference.

Braids

Clean, precise parting for knotless and feed-in styles that hold their shape as they grow out.
